genius.notes: The issuer Terms modified 2026-09-25 state that base USDai is backed 1:1 by PYUSD, while sUSDai separately holds loan-related exposure. Earlier M0/Usual/Gauntlet references do not describe the current base-USDai reserve. The Network Firm's July 15, 2026 Proof of Loans engagement covers GPU-loan attributes, not base-USDai reserve-to-liability assurance. The existing GENIUS authorization finding remains a dated negative-evidence review, not proof of an authorization or a legal conclusion.
